interface.shortDescription: Opinionated agent skills for code review, research, and daily workflow
interface.longDescription: Opinionated agent skills for the daily development loop, organized in groups: multi-perspective code review (an orchestrator plus dedicated reviewers for architecture, security, performance, interfaces, tests, and language-specific design, with cross-CLI second opinions), planning and research workflows, testing and debugging, git and session history, docs and writing, and small environment tools. Generated and synced hourly from a single source repo.
